$comment: Canonical registry for the MAM (multi-agent mesh) expansion. Source of truth for 20 leads, 200 sub-specialists, and 1 coordination router. Edit this file then run `npm run sync-agents` to regenerate the .md files. Pre-existing agents (analyst, executor, etc.) are NOT touched by the generator — they live alongside this roster.
